visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men walk toward the camera on a historic urban street lined with traditional brick buildings. Man A wears a pink suit with a bow tie and glasses; Man B wears a white pinstripe suit and carries a brown leather bag. Bystanders in winter clothing walk in the background. (2) A series of rapid jump cuts show the men in different 'walk' variations: Man B points aggressively at the camera with a shocked expression, Man B carries a book with small prosthetic legs attached, Man B wears a fake mustache and scarf, Man B dances energetically in front of a white GQ backdrop. (3) The men stand in the middle of the street; Man B appears physically exhausted, leaning forward with his hands on his bag, while Man A stands upright. (4) Man A pulls a red sachet from his jacket pocket. Close-up shots focus on the red packaging with '老協珍' branding and ginseng imagery. Man B holds the sachet near his face, looking curious. (5) Man B is shown drinking from the sachet. Man A then opens his pink suit jacket to reveal several more sachets tucked into the inner pockets. Man B reacts with an exaggerated wide-eyed stare. (6) The video concludes with Man B holding a metal fork up to his eye level while standing in front of a historic building.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, rhythmic synth BGM with a bright percussive beat begins. Two male voices speak with high energy. One voice is sharp and confrontational while the other responds with equal intensity. (2) Each visual jump cut is punctuated by a crisp 'whoosh' or 'impact' sound effect, synchronized with the rhythmic pulse of the music. The vocals consist of short, punchy phrases announcing various 'Walk' types. (3) The music ducks slightly as the dialogue becomes more conversational. One speaker exhales loudly with audible breathiness, indicating fatigue. The other maintains a higher pitch and faster speech rate. (4) A metallic 'shing' sound effect marks the reveal of a product. One voice shifts into a hyper-articulated, rapid-fire promotional tone, similar to a radio commercial. (5) Sound of liquid sipping is heard. The BGM increases in volume and spectral brightness. Both speakers' voices exhibit high arousal and positive valence, expressing excitement about 'energy'. (6) A final percussive 'ding' sound effect coincides with the appearance of a fork. The music cuts abruptly to a short silence followed by a brief comedic fade-out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage -> Dialogue -> CTA: The video begins with a rhythmic montage of themed walks, transitions into a comedic dialogue about fatigue, then seamlessly integrates a product pitch.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous, high-energy 'wordplay' format to promote Lao Xie Zhen Ginseng Essence, targeting a young audience by blending meme culture (Suit Walk trends) with explicit product endorsement.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed verbal description of product benefits (ginseng content), close-up product shots, and price mention.
